analyst.summary: Aadhar Housing Finance is a fast-growing, fully secured affordable-housing lender that just crossed Rs 30,000 crore in loans under management, with improving asset quality and healthy returns. Management has laid out a credible path to nearly double loans under management by FY29. We rate this a Hold: fundamentals are genuinely strong, and the valuation looks fair for the growth on offer, without an obvious mispricing in either direction.
